bluf: Blue Corona is a US home services agency for the trades that sold managed WordPress websites, SEO, PPC, Google Business Profile, email and lead capture, and whose record ends at its 2024-10 merger into sister agency RYNO Strategic Solutions under EverService Holdings, a Sunstone Partners portfolio company. It is doing nothing new on its own site: the sitemap lists 153 URLs with 0 updated in 90 or 365 days, and RYNO is the surviving brand. What a rival should know: its four named clients are names only, two of them already sit on the RYNO book, and the Monsoon read of 72.9 puts the book at Landfall, buying on price.
doing:
The positioning line reads: home services digital marketing agency for the trades, selling managed WordPress websites, SEO, PPC, Google Business Profile, email and lead capture. In plain words, a bundled website plus lead generation retainer for contractors. The headline claim calls it the #1 home services marketing agency, helping trades create, capture and convert more web leads; a claim.

The service list runs from SEO, local SEO and website design through pay per click, Google Local Services, Yelp and OTT advertising, social and email to Google Business Profile, Lead Capture Live and Tracking & Reporting; Lead Capture Live and Blue Corona Chat are the proprietary products and no partner is listed. Three lines lead at a score of 3: Paid Search (the title names PPC and a PPC case slug exists), SEO (four SEO focused case study slugs) and Web & Product (the homepage leads with managed WordPress sites, hosting, security and maintenance). Core lines scored 2 are Data & Measurement (its JSON-LD calls it an analytics and optimization company), Email & CRM (two email marketing case study slugs, one an HVAC case) and Local. CRO, creator, paid social and programmatic score 1 with no note; AI search, AI automation, B2B, content and retail media score 0.

On AI the record is silent: no posture line, no AI capability of any kind, 1 AI topic URL in the sitemap.

One move is on the record: 2024-10, merged with RYNO Strategic Solutions, RYNO kept as the surviving brand; the site banner says so and the sitemap stopped changing at the October 2024 merger post. Pricing signals are a free consultation and the promise that clients own their website, code, content and logins outright; no public pricing model is listed. Absent for an agency of this kind: case study text, jobs, news, offices, an employee count and a founding date; the prominence note credits only a contractor podcast and webinars.
clients:
The client type is local: contractors in the trades. The record lists verticals from contractors, electrical, flooring, franchises and garage door through HVAC, landscaping, moving, painting, pest control and plumbing to remodeling, roofing, solar, storage and windows and doors. The home market is the US, with no offices listed.

The needs read holds 4 clients and all 4 are named only. Arctic Air Conditioning and Units Moving and Portable Storage are slugs; Penguin Air, Plumbing & Electrical and GAC Services are case study pages. The GAC Services URL reads ACCA contractor of the year sees 300% growth with Blue Corona, a claim in a slug rather than described work. For all four the need is inferred from what Blue Corona leads with, paid search, SEO and web build, which for the trades reads as local and lead generation. The capability notes add signals the table does not carry, a PPC case slug, four SEO focused slugs and two email marketing slugs including an HVAC case, so paid performance, organic demand and CRM and owned audiences are the observed shapes of its work with the client behind each unnamed.

Two of the four also sit on another tracked book: Penguin Air, Plumbing & Electrical and GAC Services both appear on ryno-strategic-solutions, the surviving brand of the 2024-10 merger: the same relationships carried across, not clients shopping between rivals.

What the base needs next: the mix is most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, on paid search and SEO hours, and P3 is partial, local sold at depth with no LSAs or Sponsored Places work showing. It is likely, moderate confidence, that these contractors need LSAs and Sponsored Places run as core work next, and roughly even chance they need answer visibility under KJ2 before the book notices.

openings:
The strongest opening is the transition. Brand status is merged: the banner says Blue Corona and RYNO Strategic Solutions have merged, the sitemap stopped changing at the October 2024 post and RYNO is the surviving brand, so clients in a transition answer the phone. Very likely, high confidence, every Blue Corona relationship is now a RYNO relationship, contestable on RYNO terms. Falsifier: fresh sitemap activity on bluecorona.com or a case study dated after 2024-10 would show the brand still selling.

Second, price: displacement reads 74.9 on the Monsoon read, the book buys on price and an offshore delivered rival can undercut it line by line; likely, moderate confidence, since the read is inferred rather than observed. Third, it sells PPC and runs no Google ads of its own, which a rival can say out loud. Fourth, P3 is partial: Google Local Services sits in its nav yet no LSAs or Sponsored Places work shows, so an offer led by LSAs undercuts the bundled website retainer. Fifth, with no public pricing model (P5 unknown) and no AI capability at all (P1 absent), a transparent outcome priced offer with an answer visibility line is a conversation the record shows it cannot have.
